summary.zh: 输入框上方显示本对话预估花费、DeepSeek 余额（含子智能体）和当前峰谷价（颜色区分 + 距下次切换倒计时），余额不足 5 元变红提醒；点开是完整用量面板，只读本机会话日志。
summary.en: Per-chat estimated spend, DeepSeek balance (subagents included) and the peak/off-peak price tag with a switch countdown on the composer strip, turning into a recharge warning below ¥5, with a full native usage panel. Reads local session logs only.
